entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Count Giuseppe Gioeni was an Italian noble who had an interest in volcanoes. He examined Etna and Vesuvius and wrote about it. This led to his being made chair of natural history at the University of Catania. The Gioeni Academy in Catania was named after him.
